mapper.select: select mn.*, mn.task_user_ids as taskUserIds, mn.task_user_names as taskUserNames, mi.Dm_Region_Name as diRegionName, mi.Dm_Code as diRegionCode, sf.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mi.dm_Drawing as diDrawing, mi.dm_Drawing as dmDrawing, pro.p_Name as pName from task_distribution mn left join sys_file sf on sf.FileId = mn.td_id left join Drawing_Management_Catalogue mi on mi.dm_Id = mn.dm_Id left join pre_project pro on pro.p_Id = mn.p_Id where mn.td_Id = #{tdId}

select mn.*, td.task_user_ids as taskUserIds, td.task_user_names as taskUserNames, mi.Dm_Region_Name as diRegionName, mi.Dm_Code as diRegionCode, mi.dm_Drawing as diDrawing, su.u_Name as checkPersonUname, ci.Ci_Name as ciName, ci.Ci_Code as ciCode, ci.Ci_Type as ciType, ci.Ci_Expection as ciExpection, ci.Ci_Compute_Expection as ciComputeExpection, pro.p_Name as pName from task_distribution_check mn left join task_distribution td on td.td_Id = mn.td_Id left join Drawing_Management_Catalogue mi on mi.dm_Id = td.dm_Id left join Check_Item ci on ci.Ci_id = mn.ci_Id left join pre_project pro on pro.p_Id = td.p_Id left join sys_user su on su.U_Id = mn.check_Person_Uid where td.Di_Id = #{diId} and td.state = 7

select mn.*, mn.task_user_ids as taskUserIds, mn.task_user_names as taskUserNames, mi.Dm_Region_Name as diRegionName, mi.Dm_Code as diRegionCode, mi.dm_Drawing as diDrawing, sf.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, pro.p_Name as pName from task_distribution mn left join Drawing_Management_Catalogue mi on mi.dm_Id = mn.dm_Id left join sys_file sf on sf.FileId = mn.td_id left join pre_project pro on pro.p_Id = mn.p_Id where mn.di_Id = #{diId} and mn.state = 7 limit 1

select mn.*, mn.task_user_ids as taskUserIds, mn.task_user_names as taskUserNames, mi.Dm_Region_Name as diRegionName, mi.Dm_Code as diRegionCode, mi.dm_Drawing as diDrawing, sf.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, pro.p_Name as pName from task_distribution mn left join Drawing_Management_Catalogue mi on mi.dm_Id = mn.dm_Id left join sys_file sf on sf.FileId = mn.td_id left join pre_project pro on pro.p_Id = mn.p_Id where mn.dm_Id = #{dmId} and mn.state = 7 limit 1

select mn.*, mi.Dm_Region_Name as diRegionName, mi.Dm_Code as diRegionCode, mi.dm_Drawing as diDrawing, ci.ci_Id as ciId, ci.Ci_Name as ciName, ci.Ci_Code as ciCode, ci.Ci_Type as ciType, ci.Ci_Describe as ciDescribe, ci.Ci_Expection as ciExpection, ci.Ci_Compute_Expection as ciComputeExpection, pro.p_Name as pName from task_distribution_check mn left join task_distribution td on td.td_Id = mn.td_Id left join Drawing_Management_Catalogue mi on mi.dm_Id = td.dm_Id left join Check_Item ci on ci.Ci_id = mn.ci_Id left join pre_project pro on pro.p_Id = td.p_Id where td.Dm_Id = #{dmId} and td.state = 7
